title: SSE UTF-8 split-codepoint handling via raw_buf + valid_up_to — correct and non-trivial
description: The SSE stream accumulates raw bytes in raw_buf before decoding, using Utf8Error::valid_up_to() to decode the valid prefix and leave the remainder for the next chunk. The drain_end = valid_up_to.max(1) handles the stuck-byte case (invalid byte at position 0 would otherwise stall forever). A contributor might 'simplify' this by using String::from_utf8_lossy(), which would silently replace invalid bytes with U+FFFD and could corrupt event IDs or state tokens. The current approach is correct.
